name: Unrestricted LP333 p37q3 full-neighborhood tabu search
hypothesis: Choosing the best admissible move from every legal compression-preserving swap, while using short tabu memory and forced uphill moves, may cross local barriers that leave random single-swap and periodic triple-swap annealing above zero.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second full-neighborhood tabu run from seed 20260727 on the exact 74 p37q3 margins, enumerating all 1336 legal swaps per state, with tenure 7 through 14 and restart after 20000 global-best-stagnant sweeps
claim_boundary: This heuristic does not prove the paper's uncompression conjecture. Only a serialized exact-zero pair independently verifying both length-333 rows, all 74 margins, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations is a candidate. A lower nonzero score is workload evidence only.

baseline.evidence: The source-correct initial state at seed 20260727 has objective 87904; the corrected periodic six-coordinate arm reached objective 6752 before this intervention was frozen.
baseline.measurement: Best independently interpretable online score before this arm is squared residual 6752, with no exact-zero candidate.

intervention.one_change: Replace random annealing proposals with an exhaustive 1336-neighbor sweep at every step, choose the minimum-objective non-tabu neighbor with global-best aspiration, accept it even uphill, assign both moved coordinates tenure uniformly from 7 through 14, and restart after 20000 sweeps without a global improvement.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: factorization-and-seed-identity
controls.purpose: Bind the mechanism to the correct slice.
controls.expected: The included baseline verifies 333=37*3^2 and reconstructs objective 87904 with all 74 exact margins at seed 20260727.

controls.name: full-neighborhood-enumeration
controls.purpose: Prove the claimed neighborhood is complete.
controls.expected: A deterministic fresh state contains exactly 1336 opposite-sign same-column swaps, and every one has an incremental objective equal to a full direct recomputation.

controls.name: mechanism-telemetry
controls.purpose: Show the new search rule fired.
controls.expected: The companion record reports 1336 neighbors, applied moves equal full-neighborhood sweeps, tenures 7 through 14, the 20000-sweep restart threshold, and self-test PASS.

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute the endpoint outside the C implementation.
controls.expected: The separate Python bit-rotation auditor recomputes both PAF vectors, all margins, row sums, objective, L1, maximum residual, compression rows, and candidate status.

controls.purpose: Bind the intervention and included correct baseline.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual reaches zero

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is zero and the independent audit verifies the prescribed compression and every full-length combined PAF equation.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen schedule completes with valid mechanism telemetry and an independently audited nonzero endpoint.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before its endpoint is written and audited.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any factorization, matched start, complete-neighborhood, source pin, binary pin, telemetry, stored-score, margin, PAF, or candidate-status control fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260727.
Enumerate all 1336 legal neighbors per sweep with tenures 7 through 14 and restart only after 20000 stagnant sweeps.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another seed, tenure, restart threshold, objective, or cap.
Run the independent bit-rotation audit before interpretation.
Do not promote a lower nonzero score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, run a second direct LP audit, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive this endpoint and use its mechanism telemetry to choose a distinct exact structural lane.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest source, neighborhood, delta, serialization, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public technical literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
